_comment: The cfdb field definition map. Data, not code — edit this file directly.
glossary        : CFBD's published metric definitions, verbatim. Do not reword.
glossary_fields : leaf field name (lowercased) -> glossary term. Only map a field here
when its UNIT matches the term. Counts vs rates belong in `canon`.
patterns        : ordered fallbacks matched on prefix/suffix -> [definition, confidence].
confidence      : high | medium | low. Applies to inferred definitions only.

glossary.DB Havoc: Percentage of plays where the defense either defended or intercepted a pass.
glossary.Excitement Index: Measures the game's entertainment value by tracking swings in win probability. Larger swings result in a higher score.
glossary.Expected Points (EP): Assigns point values to field positions based on down, distance, and yard line. A negative value means the opponent is expected to score next.
glossary.Expected Points Added (EPA): Uses EP to measure play impact by calculating the change in EP from the start to end of a play.
glossary.Explosiveness: Average EPA on successful plays. Uses the site's custom PPA model.
glossary.Front Seven Havoc: Percentage of plays where the front seven forced a fumble or recorded a tackle for loss (TFL).
glossary.Garbage Time: When one of the following is true: lead > 38 points in 2nd quarter; lead > 28 points in 3rd quarter; lead > 22 points in 4th quarter. Games can occasionally exit garbage time if extreme comebacks occur.
glossary.Havoc: Percentage of plays where the defense recorded a TFL, forced a fumble, intercepted, or broke up a pass.
glossary.Line Yards: Estimates rushing yards attributable to the offensive line using weighted yardage: losses 120%; 0-4 yards 100%; 5-10 yards 50%; 11+ yards 0%.
glossary.Open Field Yards: Average yards per carry gained more than 10 yards beyond the line of scrimmage.
glossary.Passing Downs: Defined as 2nd down with 7+ yards to go or 3rd/4th down with 5+ yards to go.
glossary.Postgame Win Probability: Estimates how often each team would win if the game were replayed using the same stats, shuffled in a different order.
glossary.Power Success: Percentage of short-yardage runs (<=2 yards on 3rd/4th down or inside the 2-yard line on 1st/2nd) converted to a 1st down or touchdown.
glossary.Predicted Points (PP): Equivalent to EP, calculated using CFBD's custom model.
glossary.Predicted Points Added (PPA): Equivalent to EPA, calculated using CFBD's custom model.
glossary.Scoring Opportunities: All offensive drives that cross the opponent's 40-yard line.
glossary.Second Level Yards: Average yards per carry gained between 5 and 10 yards beyond the line of scrimmage.
glossary.Simple Rating System (SRS): Combines scoring margin and strength of schedule to rate teams. The rating indicates expected margin vs. an average team, adjusting for home field advantage.
glossary.Standard Downs: All downs that are not Passing Downs.
glossary.Success Rate: Measures play efficiency. A play is considered successful if it: results in a touchdown; gains >=50% of yards needed on 1st down; gains >=70% of yards needed on 2nd down; gains 100% of yards needed on 3rd/4th down.
glossary.Stuff Rate: Percentage of rushing plays stopped at or behind the line of scrimmage.
glossary.Usage: Percentage of plays in which a player was directly involved. Includes passes, rushes, receptions, incompletions, and targets.

id: Primary identifier assigned by CFBD for the entity this endpoint returns. Stable across calls; the natural join key.
hometeamid: CFBD team id of the home team.
awayteamid: CFBD team id of the away team.
matchupid: Identifier for a playoff matchup slot.
collegeathleteid: CFBD athlete id for the player's college career.
nflathleteid: NFL-side athlete id for the drafted player.
collegeid: CFBD team id of the player's college.
nflteamid: Identifier of the NFL team that made the pick.
recruitids: List of recruit identifiers making up this group.
filename: Raw response file this record was loaded from. Added by the cfdb loader, not by CFBD.
name: Display name of the entity this endpoint returns.
high
displayname: Full display name intended for presentation.
school: Institution name (e.g. 'Alabama'). CFBD's canonical team label in most endpoints.
alternatenames: Other names CFBD recognises for this team; useful for matching external sources.
athletename: Player's full name as CFBD records it.
team: Team name. In most CFBD endpoints this is the school name string, NOT the numeric id.
collegeteam: Name of the player's college team.
nflteam: Name of the NFL team that made the pick.
outlet: Broadcaster or media outlet carrying the game.
playtext: Narrative description of the play as CFBD records it.
notes: Free-text notes CFBD attaches to the game (e.g. bowl or event name).
highlights: URL or reference to game highlights.
logo: URL of a team logo image.
logos: List of team logo image URLs. Typically a light and a dark variant.
color: Team primary colour as a hex string.
alternatecolor: Team secondary colour as a hex string.
season: Season year. CFBD labels a season by the calendar year it starts in.
seasontype: Segment of the season (regular, postseason, etc.). See the Vocabularies sheet.
startdate: Scheduled start, ISO 8601. Verify timezone handling before deriving a local calendar date.
starttimetbd: True when the kickoff time has not been announced; the date portion of startDate is then a placeholder.
isstarttimetbd: True when the kickoff time has not been announced.
wallclock: Real-world timestamp at which the play occurred.
firstgamestart: Start time of the first game in this week.
lastgamestart: Start time of the last game in this week.
effectiveyear: Season in which the change takes effect.
effectivestart: Date/season from which this record applies.
effectiveend: Date/season after which this record no longer applies.
startyear: First season of the tenure or span.
endyear: Last season of the tenure or span. Null usually means ongoing — confirm against the data.
transferdate: Date the player entered the transfer portal.
throughweek: Data in this record reflects results through this week.
throughseasontype: Data in this record reflects results through this season segment.
seasons: Per-season detail nested under this record.
conference: Conference name. A text label, not a foreign key — CFBD has no conference id on most endpoints.
conferencedivision: Division within the conference, where one exists.
offenseconference: Conference of the team on offense.
defenseconference: Conference of the team on defense.
collegeconference: Conference of the player's college team.
classification: Division level (fbs, fcs, ii, iii). NOTE: the conference-level vocabulary adds 'ii/iii'; see Vocabularies.
homeclassification: Division level of the home team.
awayclassification: Division level of the away team.
statname: Name of the statistic in this row. These endpoints are EAV-shaped: one row per statistic, not one column per statistic.
statvalue: Value of the statistic named in statName. Often delivered as a string even when numeric.
mediatype: Broadcast medium (tv, radio, web, ppv, mobile).
playtype: Category of play (rush, pass, punt, etc.).
provider: Sportsbook that supplied the line. Values are not normalised by CFBD - cfdb has seen both 'DraftKings' and 'Draft Kings'.
code: Coded value; see the paired label field.
competition: Playoff competition this record belongs to.
roundname: Display name of the playoff round.
roundorder: Sort order of the round within the bracket.
bowlname: Name of the bowl hosting this game.
matchuporder: Sort order of the matchup within its round.
bidtype: How the team earned its playoff bid (automatic or at_large).
qualificationreason: Explanation of how the team qualified.
qualifyingconference: Conference through which the team qualified.
eliminatedround: Round in which the team was eliminated.
modelversion: Version of the CFBD model that produced these values. Changes here can shift figures without any underlying data change.
timezone: IANA timezone of the venue. Needed to convert startDate to a correct local date.
elevation: Venue elevation. Units not stated in the spec — verify before use.
grass: True when the playing surface is natural grass.
dome: True when the venue is a dome.
gameindoors: True when the game was played indoors.
homecity: City of the player's home town.
homestate: State of the player's home town.
homecountry: Country of the player's home town.
homelatitude: Latitude of the player's home town.
homelongitude: Longitude of the player's home town.
homecountyfips: US FIPS code of the player's home county.
neutralsite: True when the game was played at neither team's home venue.
homeaway: Whether this row's team was home or away.
ishomeoffense: True when the home team had possession on this drive.
homepoints: Final points scored by the home team. Null while the game is unplayed.
awaypoints: Final points scored by the away team. Null while the game is unplayed.
offensescore: Score of the team on offense.
defensescore: Score of the team on defense.
startoffensescore: Offence's score at the start of the drive.
startdefensescore: Defence's score at the start of the drive.
endoffensescore: Offence's score at the end of the drive.
enddefensescore: Defence's score at the end of the drive.
homelinescores: Home team points by period, in order.
awaylinescores: Away team points by period, in order.
pointsfor: Points scored by the team across the span.
pointsagainst: Points conceded by the team across the span.
averagepointdifferential: Mean points scored minus points conceded per game.
completed: True when the game has finished.
conferencegame: True when both teams are in the same conference.
winpercentage: Wins divided by games. Confirm whether ties are counted as half a win.
expectedwins: Wins the team would be expected to have, given its underlying performance.
secondorderwins: Wins implied by scoring opportunities rather than actual results.
conferencechampion: True when the team won its conference.
firstroundbye: True when the team received a first-round bye.
appeared: True when the entity appeared in this context.
active: True when the record is currently in force.
isinterim: True when the coach held the role on an interim basis.
isfinal: True when this is the final poll of the season.
startperiod: Quarter in which the drive began.
endperiod: Quarter in which the drive ended.
distance: Yards needed for a first down.
yardstogoal: Yards from the opponent's goal line.
startyardstogoal: Yards from the opponent's goal line at the start of the drive.
endyardstogoal: Yards from the opponent's goal line at the end of the drive.
yardline: Yard line marker for the play.
startyardline: Yard line where the drive began.
endyardline: Yard line where the drive ended.
yardsgained: Yards gained on the play. Negative for a loss.
highlightyards: Yards gained beyond what the offensive line is credited with; the ball-carrier's contribution.
driveresult: How the drive ended (punt, touchdown, turnover, etc.).
drivenumber: Sequence number of the drive within the game.
playnumber: Sequence number of the play within the game or drive.
scoring: True when the play resulted in points.
offensetimeouts: Timeouts remaining for the team on offence.
defensetimeouts: Timeouts remaining for the team on defence.
minutes: Minutes component of a clock or duration.
seconds: Seconds component of a clock or duration.
totalplays: Total plays in the denominator of the rate fields alongside it.
successes: Count of successful plays, per the Success Rate definition.
success: Whether the play met the Success Rate criteria.
rating: Rating value produced by the model named by this endpoint. Scale differs per model — do not compare across endpoints.
overall: Composite of the offensive and defensive components in this rating.
offense: Offensive component of this rating or metric.
defense: Defensive component of this rating or metric.
elo: Elo rating. A relative strength score updated after each game.
homepregameelo: Home team's Elo rating before the game.
homepostgameelo: Home team's Elo rating after the game.
awaypregameelo: Away team's Elo rating before the game.
awaypostgameelo: Away team's Elo rating after the game.
gamecontrol: Measure of how much of the game the team spent in control.
strengthofrecord: Difficulty of achieving this team's record.
remainingstrengthofschedule: Difficulty of the schedule still to be played.
averagewinprobability: Mean win probability across the span.
homewinprobability: Probability the home team wins, at this point in the game.
wepa: Opponent-adjusted EPA (weighted EPA). CFBD's adjusted-metrics family.
pace: Tempo measure — plays or drives per unit of game time.
runrate: Share of plays that were runs.
percentppa: This player's share of the team's total PPA.
percentpassingppa: This player's share of the team's passing PPA.
percentrushingppa: This player's share of the team's rushing PPA.
percentreceivingppa: This player's share of the team's receiving PPA.
talent: Composite recruiting talent score for the roster.
averagerating: Mean recruit rating across the group.
totalrating: Summed recruit rating across the group.
averagestars: Mean star rating across the group.
bestrank: Best (lowest) rank achieved across the span.
committeerank: Rank assigned by the selection committee.
weeksranked: Number of weeks the team appeared in the poll.
weekstopten: Number of weeks the team was ranked in the top ten.
predraftpositionranking: Pre-draft ranking within the player's position.
predraftgrade: Pre-draft grade assigned to the player.
pick: Overall selection number in the draft.
attributioncomplete: True when every play in the span could be attributed to a player.
spread: Point spread. Sign convention is provider-specific — verify which team a negative favours.
homemoneyline: American-odds moneyline for the home team.
awaymoneyline: American-odds moneyline for the away team.
avgcovermargin: Average margin by which the team beat or missed the spread.
temperature: Air temperature. Units not stated in the spec — verify against the data.
dewpoint: Dew point. Units not stated in the spec.
windspeed: Wind speed. Units not stated in the spec.
weathercondition: Text description of the weather condition.
height: Player height. Units not stated in the spec — commonly inches.
weight: Player weight. Units not stated in the spec — commonly pounds.
total: Total across the components alongside it.
rate: Rate, expressed as a proportion of the relevant denominator.
totalhavocevents: Count of havoc events, not the rate. Havoc itself is a percentage - see the Glossary sheet. Divide by totalPlays to reproduce havocRate.
dbhavocevents: Count of defensive-back havoc events, not the rate. See DB Havoc on the Glossary sheet.
frontsevenhavocevents: Count of front-seven havoc events, not the rate. See Front Seven Havoc on the Glossary sheet.
explosivenessallowed: Explosiveness conceded to opponents - the defensive side of the metric. The Glossary defines Explosiveness from the offence's perspective.
totalopportunies: Count of scoring opportunities (drives crossing the opponent's 40). CFBD's field name is misspelled in the API - 'Opportunies'. Preserve the typo when reading; rename downstream.
pointsperopportunity: Points scored per scoring opportunity. See Scoring Opportunities on the Glossary sheet.
averagepredictedpoints: Mean Predicted Points across the plays in scope. See Predicted Points (PP) on the Glossary sheet.
homeid: CFBD team id of the home team. The same value as homeTeamId on endpoints that use that spelling.
awayid: CFBD team id of the away team. The same value as awayTeamId on endpoints that use that spelling.
(scalar): This endpoint returns a bare array of strings rather than objects — there are no named fields.

patterns: Rate — a proportion of the relevant denominator. Confirm the denominator against the endpoint's other fields.
Sum across the components alongside it.
